Hero.title: I turn my ideas into ready-to-use software.
Hero.description: A young full-stack developer (but primarily backend) who is passionate about creating efficient and scalable software solutions.

Biography.title: My Biography
Biography.first: My journey began in my teens when I created my first websites and Python scripts, marking the start of a true passion for computer science. It was through numerous personal projects that I developed my independence, approaching each new project as a software challenge to tackle.
Biography.second: Although I am capable of working on all aspects of an application, it is in backend engineering that I thrive the most. I enjoy designing robust architectures, optimizing complex algorithms, modeling seamless APIs, and ensuring that an application’s business logic is scalable, secure, and fast.
Biography.third: My approach to development goes far beyond just writing code. I take a keen interest in the entire software ecosystem: from containerization with Docker to code quality through unit testing. My goal is always to adopt best practices to ensure clean, reliable, and easy-to-maintain applications.
Biography.fourth: I’m naturally curious and enjoy exploring new technologies and development paradigms. This allows me to stay up to date on the latest trends and provide solutions tailored to my projects. I’m looking to apply these skills to ambitious projects within dynamic teams.

sqoot.title: Sqoot - Interactive Quiz Platform
sqoot.description: Design and development of a Kahoot-inspired quiz app powered by Angular and Spring Boot. Designed to liven up the office environment and energize trade shows, this project emphasizes interactivity and a seamless user experience.

tcpFileTransferServer.title: TCP File Transfer Server
tcpFileTransferServer.description: Development in Go of a highly concurrent client-server architecture designed for file transfer. The system simultaneously handles requests from multiple clients via the TCP protocol, while isolating administrative commands on a secure port.

legoStore.title: Lego Store - E-Commerce Store
legoStore.description: Complete development of a PHP-based e-commerce platform dedicated to the Lego universe. The project includes a full-featured checkout process for users as well as an administrative back office that enables dynamic management of the product catalog.

guessWho.title: Guess Who? - Multiplayer Game
guessWho.description: Development of a native app in Kotlin and JavaFX that reimagines the famous board game. The project is based on a synchronous multiplayer architecture, allowing two users to compete in real time through a question-and-answer system.

quadtree.title: Quadtree - 2D Engine Optimization
quadtree.description: Development in Go of a 2D game environment optimized using the quadtree data structure. The implementation dynamically divides the space into quadrants to optimize graphics rendering and drastically reduce memory usage.

theShitBot.title: The Shit Bot - Desktop Application
theShitBot.description: Complete redesign of the graphical user interface for a desktop application using Angular and Electron. Based on modern mockups, I rebuilt the entire front end from scratch to optimize usability, responsiveness, and the user experience.

twitter.title: Twitter - Social Media Marketing (SMM)
twitter.description: Development and marketing of Python scripts specialized in account automation. The program accurately simulates HTTP traffic and the behavior of a real browser in order to bypass detection and security systems.
